definitions.explanation: a pricing system at restaurants, bars, or events where customers pay a fixed fee for unlimited drinks within a set time period

examples.japanese: ⟦{二時間|にじかん}→二時間：27637_nijikan⟧{飲|の}み{放題|ほうだい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{三千円|さんぜんえん}です。
examples.english: It's 3,000 yen for two hours of all-you-can-drink.

examples.japanese: {飲|の}み{放題|ほうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
{飲|の}み{放題|ほうだい}だ⟦からといって→からといって：30623_karatoitte⟧⟦{飲|の}みすぎ→飲みすぎ：22059_nomisugi⟧ないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: Just because it's all-you-can-drink doesn't mean you should drink too much.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (drinking) + ⟦{放題|ほうだい}→放題：03151_houdai⟧ (as much as one likes) → unlimited drinking

TYPICAL STRUCTURE:
- {時間制|じかんせい}{飲|の}み{放題|ほうだい} (time-limited all-you-can-drink)
- 90{分|ぷん}/⟦{二時間|にじかん}→二時間：27637_nijikan⟧{飲|の}み{放題|ほうだい} (90-minute/2-hour all-you-can-drink)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{飲|の}み{放題|ほうだい} is extremely common at Japanese ⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧ (izakaya), especially for group gatherings and ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧ (drinking parties). It typically includes beer, sake, shochu, soft drinks, and sometimes cocktails.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}→食べ放題：08291_tabehoudai⟧ (all-you-can-eat)
- ⟦{放題|ほうだい}→放題：03151_houdai⟧ suffix (as much as one likes)
- ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧ (drinking party)

USAGE:
Often combined with ⟦{食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}→食べ放題：08291_tabehoudai⟧ as a package deal (⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧{飲|の}み{放題|ほうだい}).
